action_items: Reset / re-seed the non-admin test user 'srubio@megasoft.com.ve' with password 'Test1234!' so that negative RBAC tests can run (or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md with a working non-admin).
critical_code_review_comments: sales_reports.py _format_phase_timeline uses (q.get('archived_trigger') or '').lower().startswith('enviada a imple') for is_to_project but _detect_irregularities uses _is_to_project_trigger() which also handles 'status_enviada_imple'. The two checks are inconsistent: a quote with archived_trigger='status_enviada_imple' will be detected as to_project for irregularity but the timeline rendering won't substitute archived_at into sent_to_implementation_at because the startswith check fails. Recommend reusing _is_to_project_trigger in _format_phase_timeline for consistency.

quote_history.py upload_history_attachment hard-codes is_subsana=True for ALL categories including 'Otros' which (per modal text 'no normaliza fases') should not flag is_subsana. Suggest only setting is_subsana=True when category in SUBSANA_CATEGORY_MAP.
